description: Zonas de Protección para a Avifauna contra liñas eléctricas is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Protection zones for avifauna against high-voltage electric flakes. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Protection Zones for Avifauna against electric rings" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2015-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
